request: Home Base is a better name than Juice Corner, because the app now runs my whole family routine, not just the juice orders I used to track.
The theme should be purple instead of ink, because the dark ink colour made my notes hard to read on the bus, and purple feels warmer.
Little Helper is a better name than Bakery, since the app now helps me with orders, reminders and small jobs, not just bread.
I would like the colour grey rather than mint, because the mint was too bright on the shop counter, and grey lets the stock levels stand out.
The target should begin at 6 rather than 3, because my classes meet six times a week, and it saves me setting it every Monday morning.
Daybook suits it better than Speaking practice, because I write a short note in it every day about how my lessons went.
The target should begin at 4 rather than 5, since that is the number my herd checks need each week, and I want it right from the first screen.
The budget should start at 240000 instead of 80000, because that is the figure my shop has to hold for the year, and I like seeing it first.
My Tracker is the name I want, since the app keeps my bike payments and the instalment dates in one place, and Bike Installments said too little.
The target should begin at 3.2 rather than 4, because that is the number I can keep up with on a normal week, and it saves me a change.
Pulse is a better name than Rummy Nights, because the app now tracks how my household is doing week to week, and the old name was a game.
Could the theme go blue instead of ocean? The teal shade was too dark for the bright afternoon sun, and blue keeps the figures clear.
I want the colour to be blue rather than ocean, since the teal looked muddy on the tablet, and blue keeps the screen calm.
My Tracker would suit the app better than Chore sprint, because I track my chores and the time each one takes, and the name sounded like a race.
The colour should go teal instead of slate, because the grey felt flat for an app I check every morning, and teal feels fresh and clear.
